content.short: Evolutions is an NFT project built around levelling and evolving your companions. Using CIP68 NFT technology you can instantly evolve your companions over smart contracts.
content.description:
Evolutions, is a Pokemon style NFT project bringing levelling, evolutions, and battle arena game. Using the next gen of NFTS (CIP 68) we can level up your nft and evolve your nft over smart contracts instantly. GEN 1 has 6 companions each with their own evolution line. Starter, LVL 10 Evo, and LVL 20 Evo.

GEN 1 mint date: Febuary 2024

Evo Stone mint date: Jan 26th, 2024

Mint Price: 10-15ADA Launchpad: Saturn Supply: 1000

Join the Evolutions Discord or Follow us on Twitter.
